transcript.text: Hi everyone. Before we finalize the launch plan for the real-time collaboration service going live Monday at 09:00 UTC, we need to run through the standard readiness review. That gives backend engineering, reliability, privacy, and customer success a final check-in before I record the binding policy. I'd like to hear from each of you — are there any concerns or issues we should address before we lock this down?

transcript.text: I have a concern about the retry interval in the launch plan. While investigating an unrelated mobile performance report this afternoon, I confirmed that mobile clients resume from background in bursts and currently retry every 5 seconds, which can create a reconnect storm. The rollout policy should set the retry interval to exactly 30 seconds instead of relying on the client library's default 5-second interval. I haven't filed the client-library ticket yet, but this needs to be addressed before we finalize the plan.

transcript.text: I have a concern about the connection limit in the launch plan. I completed a production-traffic replay 20 minutes ago and confirmed that the collaboration cluster's safe connection ceiling for Monday is exactly 6,000 concurrent connections — not the 10,000 currently in the draft. The autoscaling limit hasn't been updated yet because the replay results are still being attached to the capacity worksheet. We need to lower the limit to 6,000 before finalizing the plan.

transcript.text: I have a concern about the data residency and retention settings in the launch plan. I completed a privacy review this morning and confirmed two things: first, collaboration content for EU accounts must remain in the EU processing region — the current plan stores all collaboration data in the primary production region, which would violate that requirement. Second, session transcripts must be deleted after exactly 30 days, not the 90 days currently in the draft plan. I haven't opened the compliance ticket yet because legal was still reviewing the wording, but both of these need to be corrected before we finalize the plan.

transcript.text: I have a concern about the initial rollout accounts in the launch plan. I reconciled the customer-success rollout spreadsheet an hour ago and confirmed that accounts acct-204, acct-219, acct-233, acct-241, acct-278, and acct-301 have administrator opt-out commitments until their enablement sessions are complete. Those six accounts must be excluded from Monday's 10% rollout. I haven't updated the launch checklist yet, but this needs to be addressed before we finalize the plan.
